How do I know if I have Nonenal?

Nonenal, a natural compound that's created when skin oils oxidize, is characterized by a greasy or musty smell. This usually happens after 40 when a decline in our skin's antioxidants occurs due to aging.

Common Questions

What is persimmon soap and how does it work?

Our Persimmon Soap eliminates Nonenal (by 97% compared to only 35% by conventional soaps), the source of aging body odor referred to as “old person smell”. Unlike other persimmon soaps that use persimmon juice (0.1% tannins), our formula uses a concentrated persimmon tannin extract that is clinically proven to eliminate all types of body odor. (in)

Does it have a strong fragrance?

No, it has a light, natural scent derived from its ingredients, offering freshness without synthetic fragrances.

When should I use it?

For best results, use the soap daily in the shower or bath, focusing on the 5 areas where Nonenal odor is more pronounced.
